description: Create organized GM session notes for a tabletop RPG game. Create a document with title 'Shadowmere Crypts - Session 7 Notes' (Heading 1, centered). Add three sections with Heading 2: 'Active Quests', 'Key NPCs', and 'Random Encounters'. The Key NPCs section should have a table with 3 columns (Name, Role, Important Info) and at least 3 NPC entries. The Random Encounters section should have a table with 2 columns (Roll d6, Encounter) and at least 3 encounter options. Save as /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/session_notes.docx.
